units: <cite ref="Gittin 19b:15">Gitt. 19ᵇ</cite> <he>בדקינן ליה במיא דנ׳</he> we examine the sheet with a violet-colored liquid (to bring out any faded writing).
Ab. Zar. 28ᵇ אודדא דנ׳ Ar. (ed. אודרא דנדא; Ms. M. דנורא) violet-dyed wool. [R. Ḥan.: מיא דנ׳ decoction of the bark of the pomegranate-tree, Pers. nâr, Perl. Et. St., p. 37, sq.]
